Title: Global Knowledge Senior Data Analyst

Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager , this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities. The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations. What You’ll Do (Impact Areas) Data Analysis & Business Insights Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness. Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities. Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making. Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance. Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness. Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact. Data Products & Value Creation Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions. Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions. Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential. Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value. Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data. Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements. Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes. Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions. AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities. Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support. Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities. Business & Technology Partnership Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements. Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions. Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner. Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes. Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products. Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions. Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation. Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value. What Success Looks Like Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases. Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making. Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance. Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions. AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity. Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem. Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams. Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth. Core Competencies Data analysis and analytical thinking. Business intelligence and data visualization. Data storytelling and executive communication. Business requirements gathering and translation. Problem-solving and root cause analysis. Data quality and governance. AI and digital technology awareness. Customer-centric thinking. Cross-functional collaboration. Stakeholder management and influence. Business and commercial acumen. Continuous improvement mindset. Project coordination and execution. Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity. Required What You Bring (Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions. Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources. Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements. Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment. Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools. Preferred Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives. Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions. Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation. Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments. Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics. Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants. Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations. Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products. Work Model & Travel Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements. Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization. Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs. Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams. Our Commitment to You Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability. Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products. Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions. Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders. A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact. Title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
Industries: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing and Plastics Manufacturing
Description: Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility? Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. Main Responsibilities Analyze and monitor Supply Chain data to identify operational issues, trends, and opportunities for process improvement. Support daily SAP transactions and troubleshoot system-related issues across Supply Chain planning processes. Investigate and resolve IDOC errors to ensure accurate and timely data integration between systems. Manage and support COGI transactions, identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions with cross-functional teams. Perform data analysis and reporting to support inventory management, production planning, logistics, and order fulfillment activities. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Customer Service teams to improve data accuracy and process efficiency. Support and optimize business processes within SAP, primarily in the MM (Materials Management), PP (Production Planning), and SD (Sales & Distribution) modules. Develop dashboards, reports, and KPIs to provide visibility into Supply Chain performance and support decision-making. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and system enhancement projects. Required Profile Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field. Previous experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Production Planning, or related areas. Hands-on experience working with SAP, specifically within MM, PP, and SD modules. Practical experience with IDOC monitoring and resolution and COGI transaction management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret and manage large datasets. Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal) required. Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with reporting and data visualization tools is a plus. Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently. At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

Title: Senior Water Data Scientist
Description: This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You can be based in our office in our office in Washington, DC or Mexico City, Mexico .  Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position. To be eligible for this position in US, you must be a resident of DC, Maryland or Virginia at the start of employment. The Senior Water Data Scientist will serve as the technical and scientific lead for a flagship initiative focused on advancing how the impacts of nature-based solutions (NBS) and green-gray infrastructure (GGI) on water security outcomes are measured and monitored across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and beyond. This role will help shape a next-generation approach to understanding causal inference and attribution for how NBS influence water availability, water quality, hydrologic regulation, drought resilience, flood risk, and watershed resilience, by convening partners to build the scientific methodologies and digital architecture that will make monitoring and measuring the water outcomes of NBS credible and accessible at scale. The Senior Water Data Scientist will work with an interdisciplinary team across WRI’s Cities4Forests, Water Program, Global Nature Watch, Data Lab, and regional offices to identify, evaluate, and apply the best available science, data, models, artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and other emerging technologies for impact measurement and monitoring (IMM). The role will help bridge cutting-edge scientific research with practical implementation needs for utilities, investors, governments, and practitioners. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: planetary causal inference -> integrating planetary-scale data and localized information to derive insights about causality AI, machine learning and data-driven environmental modeling -> Orchestrating research and scientific development with AI, such as expertise with geospatial foundation models (GFMs), experience with AI-assisted coding, and firm foundation in statistical and machine learning methods remote sensing and Earth observation geospatial analytics and environmental monitoring environmental data systems and impact measurement frameworks hydrology and watershed science forest-water dynamics and ecosystem processes integrated water resources management The role requires a strong ability to synthesize emerging science and technology into actionable methodologies, frameworks, and recommendations that support investment-ready, scientifically credible approaches to monitoring water outcomes from NBS and GGI. Scientific Leadership (50%) Lead the technical development of research and analytical approaches related to measuring and monitoring the impacts of NBS and GGI on water security outcomes in LAC. Lead and contribute to landscape syntheses, technical assessments, and methodological reviews related to hydrology, watershed monitoring, Earth observation, remote sensing, AI-enabled analytics, and environmental data systems. Identify scientific, methodological, and data gaps that constrain credible measurement of water outcomes from NBS and GGI and help define pathways for future innovation and system-scale monitoring breakthroughs. Evaluate the strengths, limitations, feasibility, and investment relevance of existing and emerging monitoring approaches, indicators, and data products. Develop scientifically rigorous and policy-relevant recommendations for impact measurement and monitoring frameworks, indicators, methodologies, and monitoring strategies. Possibility to manage other technical experts to deliver the project. AI-Enabled Methods & Monitoring (20%) Manage, analyze, and synthesize large and complex environmental datasets, including hydrologic, geospatial, remote sensing, climate, and ecological datasets. Contribute technical expertise to the development of pilot monitoring approaches and applied field implementations with regional partners. Support development and evaluation of advanced analytical approaches, including geospatial modeling, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and satellite-based monitoring systems where relevant. Author and co-author high-quality knowledge products including reports, technical papers, synthesis documents, presentations, blogs, and peer-reviewed publications. Help shape a long-term “technical vision” related to scalable water monitoring systems, foundational environmental datasets, and future “water cycle intelligence” approaches. Project Development and Project Management (15%) Co-lead the development and implementation of a multi-year initiative advancing water security impact measurement and monitoring for nature-based solutions and green-gray infrastructure. Coordinate interdisciplinary collaboration across WRI teams and external partners, including research institutions, utilities, NGOs, technical advisors, and implementation partners. Manage technical workstreams, project deliverables, timelines, peer review processes, and partner relationships to ensure high-quality project execution. Co-lead the design and implementation of pilot projects and demonstration activities to test, validate, and refine monitoring approaches under real-world conditions. Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, strategic partnerships, and donor engagement to expand WRI's water security and environmental data portfolio. Experiencia con un orquestador (Dagster, Airflow) y con ingesta administrada (Airbyte, Fivetran o equivalente). PostgreSQL y/o un warehouse analítico (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery), con desempeño y costo en la cabeza. Haber construido capa semántica o modelos de BI para que otros consulten por su cuenta (Omni, Looker, Hex, Metabase, Power BI, Otras herramientas de BI). Comunicación con negocio. Convertir una pregunta ambigua en una definición de métrica que aguante discusión, y defenderla con datos. Haber mentoreado a otros ingenieros y dejado estándares que sobrevivieron. Español nativo e inglés profesional (documentación y herramientas en inglés). Suma puntos: GCP o AWS e infraestructura como código (Terraform, Pulumi o CDK). Arquitecturas Rest API, GraphQL y Microservicios Experiencia con datos clínicos o de salud y con requerimientos de privacidad y cumplimiento. You will own initiatives end-to-end, using data, automation, and AI to identify opportunities, design solutions, and improve both the customer experience and operational efficiency. Description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For As a Master Data Coordinator II, you will be the guardian of our customer data accuracy, directly impacting our enterprise operations, compliance, and customer experience. You will govern customer master data across our core systems, solve complex data issues, and ensure our order-to-cash processes run smoothly. This role is for you if you treat clean data as a critical deliverable and thrive on ensuring operational excellence in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities Create, update, validate, block/unblock, and deactivate customer master data records in source and MDM systems (e.g., Oracle EBS, Salesforce, SAP, or equivalent ERP/CRM/MDM platforms) in line with defined data standards and SLAs. Process master data service requests and tickets accurately and within agreed turnaround times; triage, prioritize, and escalate complex or non-standard cases as needed. Perform routine and ad-hoc data quality checks, identify anomalies, and execute remediation (deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and hierarchy maintenance). Investigate and resolve duplicate records; apply merge and survivorship decisions according to governance rules. Validate customer data against external reference sources (tax/VAT IDs, DUNS, sanctions/denied-party screening, address validation) and internal policies. Support compliance and control activities, including SOX-relevant controls, audit evidence requests, and segregation-of-duties requirements. Maintain and update master data documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Collaborate cross-functionally to resolve data issues, support customer onboarding, and unblock downstream order-to-cash processes. Contribute to data governance initiatives, system enhancements, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for MDM/ERP/CRM changes. Generate and review data quality reports and dashboards; track and report on KPIs and SLA performance. Mentor and provide day-to-day guidance to Coordinator I / junior team members, including peer review of their work where required. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field — or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of experience in master data management, data administration, data governance, or a related data operations role. Hands-on experience with at least one ERP, CRM, or MDM platform (e.g., Oracle EBS, SAP, Salesforce, Informatica/Reltio MDM). Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables, basic data manipulation). Strong written and verbal communication in English. Ability to independently manage a queue of requests and prioritize against SLAs. Preferred Qualifications Experience specifically with customer master data, including hierarchies, deduplication, and merge/survivorship processes. Familiarity with data quality and reporting tools (Power BI, SQL, Power Automate, or similar). Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOX) and audit support. Exposure to M&A data integration, system migrations, or large-scale data remediation projects. Additional language skills relevant to the region(s) supported. Core Competencies Data quality & accuracy mindset — treats clean data as the deliverable, not an afterthought. Analytical problem-solving — investigates root causes rather than just clearing tickets. Process & control orientation — follows governance rules and respects segregation of duties. Stakeholder collaboration — communicates clearly across business and technical teams. Ownership & time management — manages a workload independently and meets commitments. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Building ingestion across batch, streaming, and SDK paths — source connectors, HTTP API, Web/Mobile SDK, Data Prep mapping. Building audiences (batch, streaming, edge) and activating them to streaming, cloud storage, and custom API destinations. Writing Query Service SQL for profile QA, audience validation, and derived datasets. Integrating RTCDP with the wider Experience Cloud stack (AJO, CJA, Analytics, Target). Implementing governance: DULE labels, consent policies, Privacy Service, sandbox promotion. Troubleshooting ingestion, identity stitching, and activation failures in production. Advising customer stakeholders on design and best practice, and handing over knowledge so what you build survives you. What makes you a great fit: 3+ years hands-on AEP / Real-Time CDP — schemas, profile, identity resolution, segmentation, destinations. Implementation experience, not configuration-only. You should be able to walk through at least two RTCDP builds you personally delivered. Strong SQL. This is the one the hiring manager cares most about — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning, and real Query Service work. 3+ years API integration — REST, auth patterns, Adobe Developer Console / Adobe I/O, OAuth server-to-server. Client-facing consulting experience — leading technical workshops, presenting design decisions, handling scope conversations. Working knowledge of Python. Scripting and automation level is fine — you don't need to be an engineer. JavaScript enough to implement and debug Web SDK / tag-based collection Professional English for daily work with distributed teams and enterprise customers.
